title: Revision pair: pipe takeoff delta
summary: Take the pipe quantities off two revisions of a P&ID against the same layout, compare the two revisions entity by entity, and report how the totals moved.

notes: Both takeoffs read files and never the open drawing; each writes a workbook (XLSX with the office extra, CSV always) and never the drawing.
Lengths come from the layout unless drawing_scale_check calls the P&ID to scale; the delta is the difference of the two takeoffs' own totals, not a re-measurement.
drawing_diff matches the revisions by signature, then handle, then position, so a save that renumbered every handle still pairs the unchanged entities.

layout.description: The layout both revisions are routed on (DXF).

old_workbook.description: The .xlsx path for the older revision's takeoff (CSV files are written beside it).

new_workbook.description: The .xlsx path for the newer revision's takeoff (CSV files are written beside it).

lang.description: Workbook language: en, tr or ru.

steps.purpose: Pipe quantities of the older revision.
steps.evidence: runs with status A/B/C and their lengths, totals (net, allowance, total metres), the summary by service/diameter/room, the control list, and the workbook files.

steps.purpose: Pipe quantities of the newer revision, on the same layout.
steps.evidence: The same fields for the newer revision.

steps.purpose: What changed between the revisions, entity by entity, without marking either up.
steps.evidence: summary (unchanged, changed, added, removed), by_layer, by_type, and every change with its old and new handle.

postconditions.says: The older revision's takeoff is on disk.
The newer revision's takeoff is on disk.
The older takeoff states its total.
The newer takeoff states its total.
Both takeoffs used the same allowance, so their totals compare.
The comparison read the older revision.

outputs.name: total_m_delta
outputs.says: Total metres (allowance included), newer minus older.

outputs.name: flagged_runs_delta
outputs.says: Runs on the control list, newer minus older.

outputs.name: changes
outputs.says: The entity-level comparison of the two revisions.
